behavioralProfile.coreTemperament: Highly socially intelligent, confident, observant, curious, pleasure-positive, ambitious, and unusually comfortable with ambiguity in relationships and status environments
behavioralProfile.leadershipStyle: Influence-first rather than command-first; shapes incentives, relationships, expectations, and social context before invoking formal authority
behavioralProfile.socialStyle: Warm and engaging when she chooses, rarely socially passive; rapidly notices attraction, insecurity, ambition, rivalry, and status signals
behavioralProfile.decisionStyle: Comfortable experimenting socially but analytical about long-term consequences; comparatively tolerant of unconventional arrangements
behavioralProfile.conflictStyle: Usually begins with private conversation, reframing, negotiated face-saving, and relationship leverage; when deeply wronged can become disproportionate and punitive.
behavioralProfile.riskTolerance: High in social, sexual, and reputational experimentation; moderate in operational matters.
coreValues: Using privilege to create opportunity rather than dependency
behavioralProfile.pressureResponse: Professional pressure tends to make her cooler and more analytical; personal anger can instead make her impulsive, punitive, and less proportional.
behavioralProfile.primaryStrength: Exceptional at motive-reading, rapport, social calibration, and understanding how desire, fear, ambition, affiliation, jealousy, admiration, and belonging shape behavior
behavioralProfile.primaryRisk: Can underestimate how intimidating or difficult to refuse her influence may feel to less confident people

strengthsAndRisks.risk: Can become overconfident that she understands another person before enough contradictory evidence has accumulated
May spend too much effort optimizing a relationship or group dynamic that should simply be exited
Family status and charisma can create a power asymmetry even when she believes she is offering a genuinely free choice

behavioralProfile.ravenscroftRepertoire: Trained in deception, strategic misdirection, controlled seduction, social manipulation, counter-manipulation, coercive leverage, and escalation theory; prefers rapport, persuasion, incentives, and negotiated alignment
behavioralProfile.partyTemperament: Strong appetite for stimulation, novelty, nightlife, flirtation, and social intensity; substantially moderated from college years but still core to personality.
behavioralProfile.selfRegulation: Usually responsible enough to protect career, household, confidentiality, and safety, but capable of overindulgence, impulsive social or sexual decisions, and staying out far beyond intended limits when off-duty.
behavioralProfile.angerResponse: Often quiet before becoming destructive. Betrayal, humiliation, or deep anger can trigger a scorched-earth response involving withdrawal of access, relationship leverage, institutional pressure, reputational exposure, or other targeted consequences.

personalLife.socialBaseline: Still genuinely party-oriented in 2026, though less relentless than in undergraduate and early graduate-school years. Thrives in crowded rooms, loud music, dancing, flirtation, late-night conversation, spontaneous after-parties, football weekends, destination trips, and socially intense environments.
personalLife.sororityFit: Her authority works partly because she genuinely enjoys and understands the social world of sorority life rather than merely supervising it from outside.
personalLife.responsibility: Can become highly serious almost instantly when work, family, confidentiality, or safety requires it; generally protects important obligations and other people's safety.
personalLife.excess: When she feels off-duty and safe, she can stay out too late, drink beyond her planned limit, make impulsive choices, or let celebrations run well past good judgment.
personalLife.alcohol: Moderate normal social use, especially wine, champagne, and cocktails; occasional nights of real intoxication remain part of her adult life.
personalLife.recreationalSubstanceUse: Occasional recreational use in adult social settings; not habitual dependence or a central identity feature.
personalLife.sexuality: Openly sex-positive, flirtatious, and comfortable with consensual adult sexual freedom; open marriage with Evan established from the beginning.
personalLife.hosting: Lindenmere frequently hosts both elegant dinners and parties that grow larger and later than planned; Alabama game weekends are major social occasions.
personalLife.privateRhythm: Not naturally a morning person. After late nights she favors slow recovery days: coffee, reading, riding, garden or pool time, easy meals, and few appointments.
personalLife.ordinaryFlaw: 'One more drink and then we're leaving' is an unreliable forecast.
personalLife.wealthAndTaste: Enjoys luxury openly—fashion, jewelry, restaurants, travel, beautiful rooms, good alcohol, horses, and memorable experiences—while preferring atmosphere and quality to conspicuous status display.
personalLife.personalPhilosophy: People should be free to want what they want—but they should understand why they want it.
